decisions.reason: src/logsIngestionClient.ts lines 23-101 define a class that wraps the modular createLogsIngestion context, sets its own user-agent prefix, adds GZippingPolicy and exposes a custom upload; it is not the generated client shape. Its upload method is also counted separately.
Lines 18 and 59-100 split logs, run chunks via concurrentRun with default concurrency 5, call onError and throw AggregateLogsUploadError; same reusable shape as other batch-upload findings.
splitDataToChunks (lines 9-31) groups logs under a hardcoded 1,000,000-byte size using getBinarySize (6-13); handwritten utils matching the guideline example.
concurrentRun (lines 6-34) is a handwritten bounded-concurrency helper with abort handling used only by the custom upload; internal support code for the convenience upload.
GZippingPolicy (lines 12-27) gzips any request body and is added to the pipeline in the handwritten client constructor (line 48).
models.ts lines 29-79 define LogsUploadFailure, AggregateLogsUploadErrorName, AggregateLogsUploadError and its type guard; these are not REST models and exist only for the custom upload.

logsIngestionContext.ts lines 23-28 add an audience option and 43-53 derive the credential scope from it with a KnownMonitorAudience default (models.ts 11-27). The file otherwise has generated shape, so this is an edit in a generated-layout file; no generated/ counterpart is supplied to diff against.

Lines 55-71 (remove ApiVersionPolicy, add ClientApiVersionPolicy that appends api-version only when absent, with the 'Use the apiVersion defined in request url directly' comments) match the boilerplate the TypeSpec JS emitter produces in client context factories, and no handwritten signal distinguishes it here.

options.ts lines 13-23 add maxConcurrency and onError to the generated-shape LogsUploadOptions (whose contentEncoding/clientRequestId mirror the REST operation); they are consumed only by the handwritten upload.

limitations: No generated/ counterparts were supplied, so it is unknown whether src/api/operations.ts, models.ts and urlTemplate.ts differ from generator output; they appear to be modular-generator output and were not reported.
src/static-helpers/urlTemplate.ts is treated as generator-supplied helper code and not reported.

The package has no generated/ folder in the evidence, so edits inside generated-layout files (api/logsIngestionContext.ts, api/options.ts, models/models.ts) cannot be diffed against pure generator output.
static-helpers/urlTemplate.ts and api/operations.ts appear to be generator output and were not treated as customizations.
